stories.title: Judicial Restraint or Rubber Stamp? Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail ballot rules for the midterms
stories.conservative_headline: Court Sides With Bureaucracy: Justices Alito, Thomas Warn Ruling Leaves Mail Ballot Fraud Unchecked in November
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Rebuffs Trump's Attempt to Rewrite Mail Voting Rules Weeks Before Ballots Go Out
stories.poll_question: Should the courts have blocked the new mail ballot restrictions before the midterms?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Mail ballot rules were needed; courts overrode legitimate executive authority.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Rushed rules would have caused chaos and disenfranchised millions of voters.

stories.title: Inflation Fighter or Trump Saboteur? Fed hikes rates and defies the White House
stories.conservative_headline: Fed Pumps the Brakes on Trump's Boom: President Says Strong Job Growth Proves Rate Hike Was Unnecessary
stories.liberal_headline: Fed Defies Trump Pressure and Raises Rates as Inflation Refuses to Cool Under His Watch
stories.poll_question: Was the Fed right to raise interest rates?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Strong job growth means the Fed is needlessly choking off the economy.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Independent Fed must curb prices, not bend to presidential pressure.

stories.title: Record Enforcement or Cages the Size of Phone Booths? Watchdog report on 'Alligator Alcatraz'
stories.conservative_headline: Detention Works: Record 50,925 ICE Arrests in August as Crossings Hit 55-Year Low, Left Cries Over Conditions
stories.liberal_headline: Watchdog Finds Immigrants Held in Cages the Size of Phone Booths at Florida Detention Camp
stories.poll_question: Is aggressive immigration detention justified by the results?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Record arrests and historic low crossings prove tough detention deters illegal entry.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Caging people in inhumane conditions is indefensible regardless of enforcement statistics.

stories.title: Necessary War or $38 Billion Hole? CBO puts a price tag on the Iran conflict
stories.conservative_headline: Price of Peace Through Strength: Iran Neutralized and Hormuz Reopened, CBO Tally Ignores Strategic Payoff
stories.liberal_headline: Trump's Iran War Has Cost Americans Over $38 Billion So Far — And the Bill Doesn't Include the Casualties
stories.poll_question: Has the Iran war been worth the cost to America?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Neutralizing Iran's threat and reopening shipping lanes protected American security.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Billions burned on an endless war with no clear strategy or exit.

stories.title: Overdue Repairs or MAGA Takeover of the Arts? Fencing goes up around a shuttered Kennedy Center
stories.conservative_headline: Crumbling Monument to Elite Waste Finally Gets Fixed as Trump-Aligned Board Orders Long-Delayed Repairs
stories.liberal_headline: Fences Rise Around the Kennedy Center as Trump's Board Shutters America's Premier Arts Venue
stories.poll_question: Is the Kennedy Center closure about repairs or politics?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Deferred maintenance is real; critics are manufacturing outrage over basic upkeep.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A loyalist board is dismantling a cultural institution it never liked.

stories.title: Cutting Waste or Punishing Blue States? $177 billion in federal grants frozen nationwide
stories.conservative_headline: Taxpayers Win: Administration Halts $177 Billion in Grants Larded With Woke Pet Projects
stories.liberal_headline: Analysis Shows Trump Has Cut or Frozen $177 Billion in Grants Hitting Every Single State
stories.poll_question: Are the frozen federal grants waste or vital funding?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Executive has every right to halt spending on ideological boondoggles.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Congress appropriated this money; withholding it guts services in every state.

stories.title: Hoax or Existential Risk? Trump dismisses AI safety warnings as fearmongering
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Refuses to Let Doomsday Bureaucrats Strangle American AI in the Race Against China
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Calls AI Risk a 'Hoax' as Experts Warn Deregulation Leaves Americans Unprotected
stories.poll_question: Does AI need federal safety regulation now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Regulation would hand the AI race to China and kill American jobs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unchecked AI threatens jobs, privacy and safety without binding federal rules.

stories.title: Accountability or Partisan Theater? House holds billionaire Leon Black in contempt over Epstein subpoenas
stories.conservative_headline: Oversight Committee Delivers: Wall Street Billionaire Referred to DOJ for Stonewalling Epstein Probe
stories.liberal_headline: House Votes to Hold Epstein-Linked Billionaire in Contempt — Will Trump's DOJ Actually Prosecute?
stories.poll_question: Will the Epstein contempt referral lead to real accountability?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Congress must compel testimony; the wealthy don't get to ignore subpoenas.
stories.poll_option2_desc: DOJ will bury it to protect powerful men tied to Epstein's network.

stories.title: Judicial Chaos or GOP Power Grab? Missouri's congressional map thrown into limbo before Election Day
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Judges Torch Missouri's Legally Drawn Map Weeks Before Voters Head to the Polls
stories.liberal_headline: Missouri GOP's Mid-Decade Gerrymander Collapses Into Legal Chaos Two Months From Election Day
stories.poll_question: Should Missouri's redrawn map be used in November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Legislatures draw maps; courts shouldn't override them at the last minute.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A rigged mid-decade redraw shouldn't decide seats voters already started voting on.

stories.title: Polluters Held Liable or Climate Lawfare? Boulder's damages case against Exxon and Suncor reaches the high court
stories.conservative_headline: Climate Lawfare Reaches SCOTUS: Local Officials Try to Set National Energy Policy Through Damage Suits
stories.liberal_headline: Boulder Takes Oil Giants to the Supreme Court, Arguing They Intentionally Misled the Public on Climate
stories.poll_question: Should cities be able to sue oil companies for climate damages?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Energy policy belongs to Congress, not local judges and trial lawyers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should cover the costs communities now bear.
